daily.today_energy: Your intuition is absolutely *it* today. The cosmos is whispering secrets only you can hear—trust those gut feelings even when they seem random. Channel that mystical energy into something creative.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, deep conversations are flowing naturally. Single? Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Either way, vulnerability is your superpower rn.
daily.career: Your unique perspective is exactly what's needed. Don't dim your light to fit in—the work you do best comes from being authentically you. Keep showing up as yourself.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness today. Whether that's rest, movement, or just drinking water like it's a spiritual practice—listen to what feels nourishing. You deserve that care.

weekly.overview: Mercury's moving through your zone of reflection this week, Pisces. It's giving introspective energy—perfect for journaling those big feelings and getting clarity on what you actually want versus what you think you should want.
weekly.love: Venus is softening the edges around your heart. Whether you're coupled up or solo, this is your moment to practice radical honesty about what love looks like for you. No more people-pleasing scripts—just authentic connection.
